basic_details.job_title: NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Law University Delhi has invited applications for one full-time contractual IPR Chair Professor post under the DPIIT IPR Chair, with a remuneration of Rs. 1,50,000 per month and an initial one-year term. Applications are accepted online only at careers.nludelhi.ac.in up to 25 November 2026, 11:59 PM. The chair is set up by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, under the Scheme for Pedagogy and Research in IPRs for Holistic Education and Academia (SPRIHA).

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor Overview

rows.details: Initial period of one year, extension possible

content_sections.heading: About NLU Delhi
content_sections.text: National Law University Delhi is located at Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi – 110 078. The IPR Chair Professor will work full-time at the university campus in Dwarka. The post forms part of SPRIHA, and the notice refers candidates to the SPRIHA norms for detailed information.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of this post.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: A candidate is eligible for appointment as IPR Chair Professor if he meets any one of the three routes below. The notice prints them as (a), (b) and (c), joined by "or". Any individual above the age of 70 years is not eligible for appointment as IPR Chair. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. Eligibility conditions must be fulfilled as on the last date for receipt of applications. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions. Candidates willing to join on a deputation or Extra Ordinary Leave (EOL) basis are also invited to apply. Candidates currently in employment must submit their application through the proper channel.

rows.qualification: Has served as, or meets the eligibility criteria for serving as, a Professor or an Associate Professor as prescribed by the UGC
rows.experience: Sufficient teaching and research experience in Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)

rows.qualification: An IP Attorney who has practiced IPR Law, OR any other professional who has gained significant recognition in the field of IPR
rows.experience: Minimum of ten years practising IPR Law; or no less than ten years of experience in the field of IPR

rows.qualification: A retired official of the IP Office under CGPDTM, holding a doctorate degree
rows.experience: Minimum of five years of experience working at Level 12 or above, such as Controller of Patent & Design, Registrar of Trademark & Geographical Indications, or Registrar of Copyrights

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Rs. 1,50,000/- per month. TDS at 10% is deducted on the monthly remuneration as per NLU Delhi Regulations, funded by the respective Programme. The appointment is for an initial period of one year, with the possibility of extension based on satisfactory performance and the availability of funds. No additional benefits or perks will be provided. The appointment is purely temporary and confers no right to regularisation. It does not carry benefits applicable to regular faculty. The appointment is subject to verification of antecedents and may be terminated at any time due to misconduct, unsatisfactory performance, or subsequent ineligibility. The rules and regulations of National Law University Delhi apply to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor Job Description
content_sections.text: Promote teaching, research and capacity-building in Intellectual Property (IP) at the University. Develop and strengthen IP curricula across academic programmes, foster high-quality research, and contribute to building an IP knowledge base, including through engagement with global best practices. Facilitate collaborations with academic institutions, industry and other stakeholders. Support policy-oriented research and inputs on IP-related issues. Undertake outreach and awareness activities, mentor students and researchers, and publish regularly on relevant platforms.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted based on an evaluation of their application contents. Shortlisting does not guarantee an interview or final selection. Only shortlisted candidates are contacted for an interview, and the details will be communicated separately. A 3-member Committee of eminent persons, constituted by the Vice-Chancellor, reviews the applications and submits its recommendation to DPIIT. The University may also decide shortlisting on other criteria. Its decision on eligibility, shortlisting and selection is final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor
content_sections.text: The notice is dated 4 November 2026. Applications are accepted online only, up to 25 November 2026, 11:59 PM, at the careers portal given in the notice. The application fee is Rs. 1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand Only), paid online and non-refundable. SC/ST and PwD category candidates are exempted from the application fee. Visit https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in and apply online. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,000/- online, unless you belong to the SC/ST or PwD category. Support the application with the required self-attested documents/testimonials. If you are currently employed, submit the application through the proper channel. Applications that are incomplete, received after the last date, or not supported with the prescribed fee and the required self-attested documents/testimonials will be rejected. For queries, write to [email protected] . Updates, if any, will be published on the University website only ( www.nludelhi.ac.in ).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: There is one position of IPR Chair Professor, a full-time contractual post at the NLU Delhi campus, Dwarka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission is 25 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Applications received after the last date are rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IPR Chair Professor post?
faq.answer: A candidate must meet one of three routes: a Professor or Associate Professor as per UGC criteria with IPR teaching and research experience; an IP Attorney or professional with at least ten years in IPR; or a retired CGPDTM IP Office official with a doctorate and five years at Level 12 or above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor?
faq.answer: Any individual above the age of 70 years is not eligible for appointment as IPR Chair.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration of the NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 1,50,000/- per month, with TDS at 10% deducted. No additional benefits or perks are provided.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1,000/-, paid online and non-refundable. SC/ST and PwD category candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor?
faq.answer: Apply online only at https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in by 25 November 2026, with the fee and the required self-attested documents/testimonials. Employed candidates must apply through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on the contents of their applications, and only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. A 3-member Committee reviews the applications and sends its recommendation to DPIIT.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired officials apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Yes, a retired official of the IP Office under CGPDTM can apply if he holds a doctorate and has at least five years at Level 12 or above. The notice gives one remuneration for the post, Rs. 1,50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Is the IPR Chair Professor post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual post. The initial period is one year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds, and it gives no right to regularisation.
